content: A photorealistic television news broadcast scene featuring a {argument name="anchor appearance" default="female Japanese news anchor wearing a dark blue blazer over a white top"} sitting at a glass desk in a modern newsroom studio. She is smiling and looking directly at the camera, with her hands resting near a tablet, papers, and a clear water bottle. To her left, a large monitor displays the text "{argument name="screen main text" default="OpenAI 「GPT-image-2」リリース"}" alongside an AI logo and a collage of 8 smaller diverse AI-generated images. In the top left corner, a channel logo reads "{argument name="news channel name" default="GLOBAL NEWS"}" with a red "LIVE" badge. The background shows a busy office with computers and a wall screen displaying "AI Generation". At the bottom of the screen, a standard news lower-third graphic displays the anchor's name "{argument name="anchor name" default="キャスター：佐藤 陽子"}" and a breaking news headline reading "{argument name="main headline text" default="【速報】OpenAI、画期的な新型画像生成モデル「GPT-image-2」を発表。より高精細で多様な表現が可能に。"}" in bold Japanese text.

A photorealistic television news broadcast scene featuring a {argument name="anchor appearance" default="young Japanese female with shoulder-length dark hair wearing a light beige blouse"} and a small black lapel microphone, sitting at a news desk and speaking directly to the camera. The studio background is modern with blue and white lighting and a blurred nighttime city skyline on the right. In the top left corner, there is a dark blue graphic with the white text "{argument name="channel logo text" default="NEWS TODAY"}". To the anchor's left is a large presentation monitor displaying a news graphic with a white background and light blue network nodes. The monitor features a dark blue "最新情報" tag, the text "{argument name="subheadline" default="OpenAIの新しい画像生成モデル"}", a large prominent headline "{argument name="main headline" default="「GPT-image-2」"}", the text "がリリース", an OpenAI logo, and a dark blue bottom banner reading "より高精細に より正確に 画像生成の可能性がさらに広がる". Across the bottom of the entire screen is a news ticker lower third with a dark blue "速報" box and the scrolling text "{argument name="ticker text" default="OpenAI 画期的な新画像生成モデル「GPT-image-2」をリリース"}".

A photorealistic portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="beautiful young Asian woman"} with {argument name="hair style" default="long dark wavy hair with side-swept bangs"}. She wears an {argument name="outfit" default="elegant black off-the-shoulder satin dress"} and pearl stud earrings, smiling gently at the camera. The background is a {argument name="background setting" default="blurred luxurious interior with warm bokeh lights"}. Cinematic lighting, highly detailed.

A photorealistic, high-quality portrait of a beautiful young {argument name="nationality" default="Japanese"} woman. She has {argument name="hair style" default="long black wavy hair with bangs"}, dark brown eyes, fair skin, and a {argument name="expression" default="gentle smile"} while looking directly at the camera. She is wearing a {argument name="clothing" default="simple white blouse"}. The image features soft, flattering portrait lighting and a shallow depth of field, set against a {argument name="background" default="blurred warm indoor setting"} with beautiful bokeh. Shot on an 85mm lens, highly detailed.

A photorealistic image of a black Formula 3 race car undergoing an aerodynamic wind tunnel test. Thick white smoke trails flow from a front nozzle over the car's nose, halo, and rear wing. The car features the number 1 and 'F3 FIA FORMULA 3 CHAMPIONSHIP' decals, with a helmeted driver seated inside. The setting is a dark industrial facility with a metallic grid floor. On the left wall, a dark sign displays the text {argument name="wall sign text" default="流体可視化実験 (煙による流れの観察) 車両周りの空気の流れを煙を用いて可視化しています。"} alongside 'F3 WIND TUNNEL TEST'. In the bottom right foreground, a black box labeled {argument name="box label" default="スモークジェネレータ"} sits next to a computer monitor showing a live feed of the car and the telemetry text {argument name="monitor text" default="風速: 50 m/s ヨー角: 0 deg 煙: ON"}. Dramatic, realistic engineering photography.

An anime-style illustration of a figure leaning against a textured stone wall in a narrow, sunlit alleyway. The figure has a {argument name="head type" default="large yellow smiling emoji with rosy cheeks"} for a head. They wear a {argument name="outfit" default="loose black overcoat, black shirt, wide-leg black trousers, and black dress shoes"}. The character's left foot rests on a stone block, right hand in pocket, and left hand near the neck. The scene includes reflective stone pavement, a distant streetlamp, and golden-lit foliage. The notebook has horizontal ruled lines and a black metal spiral binding on the left edge. At the top, the date "{argument name="date" default="2024년 11월 24일 일요일"}" and weather "{argument name="weather" default="날씨 맑음"}" with a small sun doodle are written. A candid, realistic smartphone photo of five men having an intense discussion around a dark wooden conference table in a modern, minimalist office. On the mid-left, a man resembling {argument name="mid-left person" default="Sam Altman"} in a green sweater gestures with his hands while speaking. In the center, a man resembling {argument name="center person" default="Mark Zuckerberg"} in a grey t-shirt listens intently. On the mid-right, a man resembling {argument name="mid-right person" default="Elon Musk"} in a black jacket gestures while responding. Two other men wearing glasses and dark sweaters sit at the far ends of the table, observing with their hands near their faces. The table is cluttered with 3 white ceramic mugs, 3 clear drinking glasses, 1 silver soda can, open laptops, tablets, scattered papers, notebooks, and tangled black cables. The room features plain white walls and a large black-framed window revealing trees outside. The lighting is indoor and slightly grainy, giving it an authentic, {argument name="photo style" default="leaked behind-the-scenes"} aesthetic.

A photorealistic image of {argument name="confident person" default="Sam Altman"} standing confidently on the left with his hands on his hips, wearing a black t-shirt with white text that reads "{argument name="shirt text" default="i ship faster than you code."}". Next to him on the right is {argument name="dejected person" default="Sundar Pichai"}, looking dejected and sad with his head bowed and hands clasped, wearing a plain dark grey t-shirt. They are standing indoors in front of a large glass window. Outside the window is a sunny corporate campus with trees, a small pond, and a modern glass building with the {argument name="background company logo" default="Google"} logo prominently displayed on it.

A high-fashion editorial photograph of a female model standing in an {argument name="environment" default="arid desert landscape"} with distant mountains under a soft cloudy sky. She is wearing a spectacular, structured haute couture dress made entirely of folded {argument name="dress material" default="vintage maps"}, featuring sharp, origami-like geometric layers and a strapless bodice. She has dark hair swept up, striking facial features, and wears large circular earrings resembling compasses. Surrounding her in the air are exactly 7 floating {argument name="floating objects" default="elongated compass needles with clock faces in the center"}. The image features {argument name="lighting" default="cinematic late afternoon lighting"}, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the paper dress and the dry earth. Photorealistic, surreal fashion photography.

The bottle features a minimalist square label with a delicate flower logo and the text {argument name="brand name" default="AURÉLIA"} above "EAU DE PARFUM". The setting is ethereal and hazy, bathed in warm, golden volumetric lighting that creates glowing reflections on the rippled water surface. In the background, classical ruins emerge from the water: a fallen stone head on the left and a headless draped statue on the right. At the bottom of the image, elegant typography overlays the scene, featuring the large serif text {argument name="brand name" default="AURÉLIA"}, followed by "EAU DE PARFUM", a matching flower logo, and the tagline {argument name="tagline" default="ETERNAL. RADIANT. UNFORGETTABLE."} in a clean, spaced-out font.

In the foreground, a man in a dark utility jumpsuit carefully cleans a large, framed {argument name="art style" default="classical landscape"} painting. To the left, a classical marble bust is bound in wire. The zero-gravity environment features floating artifacts, including wrapped bundles and framed paintings suspended in mid-air. Massive arched windows reveal a breathtaking view of space. {argument name="atmosphere" default="Volumetric light rays stream through the dusty atmosphere"}, illuminating the grand, decaying architecture. A hanging dark banner reads "{argument name="banner text" default="THE MEMORY OF BEAUTY OUTLIVES US
CARE FOR IT.

MUSEUM INITIATIVE
SOL 4127"}". The lighting is dramatic and moody, emphasizing the epic scale of art preservation in space.

A {argument name="photography style" default="hyper-realistic macro photograph"} of a vibrant {argument name="animal" default="chameleon"} resting on a {argument name="setting" default="mossy branch in a lush jungle"}. The reptile features intricate, textured scales in shades of {argument name="primary colors" default="bright green, electric blue, and warm yellow"}, with a prominent, highly detailed eye. Its clawed feet tightly grip the wet, textured wood, and its tail is curled beneath. The background is a smooth, out-of-focus bokeh of deep green foliage, highlighting the sharp focus and vivid colors of the subject.

The viewer's hands are visible in the foreground, wearing white sleeves with red dashed stitching, reaching forward. A red muted microphone UI icon sits in the bottom left corner. The whiteboard features clear, handwritten black text reading "{argument name="line 1 text" default="Model: ChatGPT"}" with "{argument name="line 2 text" default="Company: OpenAI"}" written directly below it. In the bottom right corner, smaller text reads "{argument name="signature text" default="- Sam Altman CEO, OpenAI"}". The scene is set in a bright, modern office with soft natural lighting and a softly blurred background.

A breathtaking anime-style landscape featuring a vibrant, starry night sky dominated by a brilliant, sweeping Milky Way in hues of deep purple, blue, and magenta. Two prominent shooting stars, one glowing bright blue and the other a softer pinkish-red, streak downwards across the sky, their tails intersecting. In the center of the sky, written in elegant, glowing cursive neon-like script, is the text "{argument name="custom text" default="Your Name"}", underlined by a delicate pink line that forms a small bow in the middle. Below, a serene landscape unfolds with dark, silhouetted clouds framing the edges. A distant town with glowing city lights sits nestled along the shores of a calm lake, reflecting the twilight colors of the horizon where the sun has just set, leaving a gradient of pink and orange. The foreground features dark silhouettes of grassy hills and subtle hints of purple flowers, adding depth to this magical, cinematic scene reminiscent of Makoto Shinkai's art style.

To the right stands a {argument name="architectural element" default="red torii gate and two glowing stone lanterns"}. The foreground features scattered {argument name="foliage" default="red maple leaves"}. Below stretches a vast mountainous landscape with a distant lake and a peak resembling Mt. Fuji. The sky is a breathtaking gradient of deep blue, purple, pink, and orange, detailed with clouds, stars, and {argument name="sky detail" default="two shooting stars"}. The man on the left has white hair and a full white beard, wearing a {argument name="man's clothing" default="green fleece jacket"} over a maroon shirt. The woman on the right has short grey hair and glasses, wearing a {argument name="woman's clothing" default="blue denim jacket and cream scarf"}.
